title: An idea becomes a connected system — 3D Diorama preview

scenes.title: The idea rises
scenes.purpose: Establish the bounded blue-hour miniature stage and raise the central idea tower with its glowing orb.
visuals: Floating toon-shaded plinth with grass top, soil strata and ink base band on a stationary dusk-slate canvas
Camera begins a bounded orbit (18° to 45° azimuth) at constant 33° elevation
Tower extrudes, idea orb pops in, glass halo blooms, CRT screen begins drawing a node graph

beats.development: Empty plinth; the tower extrudes upward from the centre as the camera starts to orbit.
Idea orb pops onto the tower, its warm emissive glow and glass halo bloom; the tower screen starts linking nodes and the roads begin to extend.

scenes.title: The system connects
scenes.purpose: Show the idea spreading into a connected system: roads, houses, people and flow pods, ending on a settled hero view.
visuals: Four houses rise at the road ends, staggered
Back link road closes the loop; trees and figures appear
Cream pods travel from the tower to each house; each house's windows light on arrival
Camera eases into the frontal isometric hero view and holds

beats.development: Houses rise at each road end; the back road links two houses; trees pop up.
Figures appear; one pod per house travels outward along the roads and the windows light in sequence as each arrives; camera orbit settles at 2.6 s.
Complete settled scene held for reading: lit system, still camera.

findings: All motion completes by 2.61 s; the final 0.39 s is a still reading hold.
Copy is static and fully visible for the whole 3 s, so it is readable throughout.
justifiedHolds: 2.65–3.00 s closing hold so the viewer can read the completed connected system.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.

Background changed from the earlier cream swatch to a scene-dependent blue-hour slate (#1F2C34), following palette.background_policy = scene_dependent and the reviewed source frames (dusk/night stages with warm emissive accents).
